subject: Greenline VM evidence request & CVE remediation attestation
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@greenline.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM evidence + CVE attestation for upcoming SOC 2 audit

Hi Karthik,

Greenline is preparing for a SOC 2 readiness review next month and our audit team has asked for a concise vulnerability management package for Redwood as a critical vendor. The items they specifically requested:

- Scan cadence (types of scans, frequency, and owners)
- SLA commitments for CVE remediation by severity (timeline and escalation path)
- Evidence of recent remediation for CVE-2025-3141 (affected component: third-party inference runtime)
- An attestation letter we can include in the audit binder (signed)

Can you confirm you can provide a packet and a short attestation by Oct 3? I attached a short questionnaire (greenline_vm_request.pdf) with the exact fields the auditor wants.

Background: the auditor will accept a vendor attestation plus supporting artifacts (scan exports, patch tickets, and a remediation narrative). If we can get the attestation signed and a drive link, that should suffice.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Sharma
Senior Vendor Security Analyst
Greenline Bank
attachments: greenline_vm_request.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@greenline.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence + CVE attestation for upcoming SOC 2 audit

Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up and the attached questionnaire. We can absolutely assemble the package and provide a signed attestation. Proposed plan / deliverables:

1) Evidence packet (by Oct 2 EOD PDT)
   - Full export of our monthly authenticated/internal image and dependency scans (CSV + brief summary)
   - Ticket reference list for remediation of CVE-2025-3141 with timestamps and owner notes
   - Snapshot of our continuous external attack-surface scan for the relevant service

2) Attestation (by Oct 3)
   - One-page signed attestation (PDF) describing scan cadence, SLAs, and confirmation that CVE-2025-3141 was triaged and remediated across our hosted and dedicated runtimes.

3) SLA matrix (inline)
   - Critical: 72 hours to mitigation plan, 14 days to remediation where possible (exceptions documented)
   - High: 7 days to plan, 30 days to remediation
   - Medium/Low: tracked per regular patch windows (30–90 days depending on component)

We will include the specific tickets and a remediation narrative for CVE-2025-3141. Ben will attach the machine-readable scan output and the remediation checklist; Laura will review the attestation language for SOC 2 suitability; Monica will confirm signature authority and retention/archival wording.

Attachments we will send: scan_report_20250928.zip, cve-2025-3141-attestation.docx (draft).

Action items:
- Priya: confirm the auditor accepts Redwoods' vendor attestation + artifacts in lieu of on-site evidence.
- Ben: prepare export and tickets.
- Laura: finalize attestation wording.
- Monica: arrange for Exec signature (we typically route via DocuSign).

I'll push the packet to a shared drive link and send the signed PDF once complete.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence + CVE attestation for upcoming SOC 2 audit

Ack — working on the exports now. Quick notes for the packet:

- scan_report_20250928.zip will contain: SBOM-derived dependency scan (Snyk), container image vulnerability export, and our internal authenticated host scan output (Nessus).
- CVE-2025-3141 remediation: fix landed in our 2025-09-24 runtime patch; patch verified and rolled to 100% of hosted capacity on 2025-09-27. I will include the Jira references (RV-8973, RV-8981) and the verification runbook output.
- SLA matrix: I will add the escalation emails and the runbook links (ops-runbook internal).

Uploading raw exports to the drive now; will send link in the final packet.

—Ben

Karthik / Ben / Laura — thank you, this looks like exactly what we need. The auditor confirmed vendor attestations with supporting artifacts are acceptable. A few follow-ups:

- Please include a short one-paragraph public-safe narrative that we can put in the binder (no internal IP or PII).
- Can the attestation confirm whether remediation was applied to both hosted API and Dedicated/Private deployments (if applicable)?
- DocuSign would be preferred for signature; please send the envelope link when ready.

If you can send the drive link and the signed attestation by Oct 3, we should be good.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Priya
Vendor Security Analyst, Greenline Bank
